import { expect, test } from 'vitest';
import { api } from '../../convex/_generated/api';
import { backend, table, storedEvents } from './fixtures/table';
import { appendEvent } from '../../convex/lib/events';
import { journalPatch, commandJournal } from '../../convex/lib/journal';
import { noConditions, resolveEdgeBane, tierOf, testOutcome, recoveryValueOf } from '../../convex/lib/tableOperations';

// Audit probes assert the observed failure mode, not desired application behavior.
test('audit S02: nested field removal is applied but omitted from journal', async () => {
  const t = backend(); const {director,campaignId} = await table(t);
  const result = await t.run(async ctx => {
    const actor = (await ctx.db.get(director.profile.userId))!;
    const foeId = await ctx.db.insert('foes', {campaignId,name:'Probe',visible:true,sourceSnapshot:'{}',maxStamina:15,live:{stamina:15,temporaryStamina:0,conditions:noConditions()}});
    const eventId = await appendEvent(ctx,{campaignId,origin:'user',actor,commandId:'nested-removal',kind:'audit',description:'audit'});
    await journalPatch(ctx,{campaignId,eventId},'foes',foeId,{live:{stamina:14,temporaryStamina:0}});
    return {foe:await ctx.db.get(foeId), journal:await commandJournal(ctx,campaignId,'nested-removal')};
  });
  expect(result.foe!.live).not.toHaveProperty('conditions');
  expect(result.journal.changes.map(c=>c.path)).toEqual(['live.stamina']);
});

test('audit A01: two issuers same command id share accepted dice and undo unit', async () => {
  const t=backend(); const {director,player,campaignId}=await table(t);
  const args={campaignId,text:'/table roll dice="2d10"',commandId:'public-copied-roll'};
  await director.client.mutation(api.commands.submit,args);
  await player.client.mutation(api.commands.submit,args);
  const journal=await t.run(ctx=>commandJournal(ctx,campaignId,args.commandId));
  expect(journal.events).toHaveLength(2);
  expect(journal.events[0]!.actorId).not.toBe(journal.events[1]!.actorId);
  expect(journal.events[0]!.dice).toEqual(journal.events[1]!.dice);
  expect(await t.run(ctx=>ctx.db.query('rolls').collect())).toHaveLength(1);
});

test('audit A01: closed-session card executes in next session', async () => {
  const t=backend(); const {director,player,campaignId,sessionId}=await table(t);
  const opened=await player.client.mutation(api.commands.submit,{campaignId,text:'@Thorn /table roll',commandId:'open-old-session'});
  await director.client.mutation(api.sessions.transition,{sessionId:sessionId!,expectedRevision:0,action:'close',commandId:'close-old-session'});
  const next=await director.client.mutation(api.sessions.start,{campaignId,selectedPlayerIds:[player.profile.userId],commandId:'start-next-session'});
  const answered=await player.client.mutation(api.interactions.respond,{interactionId:opened.interactionId!,answer:{dice:'d6'},commandId:'answer-old-session'});
  const row=await t.run(ctx=>ctx.db.get(opened.interactionId!));
  const event=await t.run(ctx=>ctx.db.get(answered.eventId));
  expect(row!.sessionId).toBe(sessionId); expect(row!.status).toBe('resolved'); expect(event!.sessionId).toBe(next);
});

test('audit A01: same name replacement changes a cards bound actor', async () => {
  const t=backend(); const {player,campaignId,thornId}=await table(t);
  const opened=await player.client.mutation(api.commands.submit,{campaignId,text:'@Thorn /table roll',commandId:'open-named-actor'});
  const replacement=await t.run(async ctx=>{const old=(await ctx.db.get(thornId))!; await ctx.db.patch(thornId,{authored:{...old.authored,name:'Renamed'}}); const {_id,_creationTime,...copy}=old; return ctx.db.insert('characters',copy);});
  const answered=await player.client.mutation(api.interactions.respond,{interactionId:opened.interactionId!,answer:{dice:'d6'},commandId:'answer-named-actor'});
  const card=await t.run(ctx=>ctx.db.get(opened.interactionId!)); const event=await t.run(ctx=>ctx.db.get(answered.eventId));
  expect(card!.boundActor.id).toBe(thornId); expect(event!.payload.envelope.boundActor.id).toBe(replacement);
});

test('audit A01: closing a card writes no activity event and lacks a registered operation', async () => {
  const t=backend(); const {player,campaignId}=await table(t);
  const opened=await player.client.mutation(api.commands.submit,{campaignId,text:'/table roll',commandId:'open-close-probe'});
  const before=(await storedEvents(t,campaignId)).length;
  await player.client.mutation(api.interactions.close,{interactionId:opened.interactionId!,commandId:'close-close-probe'});
  expect((await storedEvents(t,campaignId)).length).toBe(before);
  expect((await player.client.query(api.commands.list,{campaignId})).map(op=>op.id)).not.toContain('card.close');
});

test('audit A03: hidden Malice and difficulty leak through public history', async () => {
  const t=backend(); const {director,player,observer,campaignId}=await table(t);
  await director.client.mutation(api.commands.submit,{campaignId,text:'/adjust malice value=47',commandId:'malice-leak-probe'});
  await player.client.mutation(api.commands.submit,{campaignId,text:'@Thorn /test roll characteristic=M value=2 difficulty=hard',commandId:'difficulty-leak-probe'});
  expect((await observer.client.query(api.table.roster,{campaignId})).malice).toBeNull();
  const events=(await observer.client.query(api.events.list,{campaignId})).events;
  expect(events.find(e=>e.commandId==='malice-leak-probe')!.description).toContain('0 → 47');
  expect(events.find(e=>e.commandId==='malice-leak-probe')!.payload.data.after).toBe(47);
  expect(events.find(e=>e.commandId==='difficulty-leak-probe')!.payload.data.result.difficulty).toBe('hard');
  expect(events.find(e=>e.commandId==='difficulty-leak-probe')!.description).toContain('; hard:');
});

test('audit A03: observer roster receives peers heroic resource and XP',async()=>{
  const t=backend(); const {director,observer,campaignId}=await table(t);
  await director.client.mutation(api.commands.submit,{campaignId,text:'@Thorn /adjust heroic-resource value=7',commandId:'hero-resource-probe'});
  const roster=await observer.client.query(api.table.roster,{campaignId});
  expect(roster.heroes[0]!.live!.heroicResource.current).toBe(7);
  expect(roster.heroes[0]!.live).toHaveProperty('xp');
});

test('audit A03 R04: hand-derived tier boundaries, cancellations, outcomes and rounding',()=>{
  expect([11,12,16,17].map(n=>tierOf(n,0))).toEqual([1,2,2,3]);
  expect([tierOf(2,-1),tierOf(11,1),tierOf(16,-1),tierOf(17,1)]).toEqual([1,2,1,3]);
  expect([[1,0],[0,1],[2,0],[0,2],[3,1],[1,3],[3,3]].map(([e,b])=>{const r=resolveEdgeBane(e!,b!);return [r.modifier,r.tierShift];})).toEqual([[2,0],[-2,0],[0,1],[0,-1],[2,0],[-2,0],[0,0]]);
  expect([1,2,3].map(t=>testOutcome(t as 1|2|3,false,'easy'))).toEqual(['Success with a consequence','Success','Success with a reward']);
  expect([1,2,3].map(t=>testOutcome(t as 1|2|3,false,'medium'))).toEqual(['Failure','Success with a consequence','Success']);
  expect([1,2,3].map(t=>testOutcome(t as 1|2|3,false,'hard'))).toEqual(['Failure with a consequence','Failure','Success']);
  expect(testOutcome(3,true,'hard')).toBe('Success with a reward');
  expect([30,31,32,33].map(recoveryValueOf)).toEqual([10,10,10,11]);
});

test('audit A03: foe list bypasses winded-only audience projection',async()=>{
  const t=backend(); const {director,observer,campaignId}=await table(t);
  await t.run(ctx=>ctx.db.insert('foes',{campaignId,name:'Goblin',visible:false,sourceSnapshot:'{}',maxStamina:15,live:{stamina:12,temporaryStamina:0}}));
  await director.client.mutation(api.commands.submit,{campaignId,text:'/campaign health-display mode=winded',commandId:'winded-only-probe'});
  expect((await observer.client.query(api.table.roster,{campaignId})).foes[0]!.health).toEqual({mode:'winded',winded:false});
  expect((await observer.client.query(api.foes.list,{campaignId})).rows[0]!.healthFraction).toBe(0.8);
});
